definition_en: a small-seeded cereal grass grown for its grain, or the grain itself
core_image: 一穗沉甸甸的小粒谷物，颗粒细碎得能握满一把
scene: 干旱的村落里，人们把耐旱的小粒谷物晒在屋顶上。Families in the dry village spread their millet on the flat roof to dry.
sceneCN: 这里 millet 是「黍类谷物」（第 1 个义项：一种小粒谷物作物）；句意：干旱村落的人家把黍米摊在平屋顶上晾晒。

derivatives.zh: 以黍米为主的，由 millet 加 -based 构成
作物的种子，由 millet 与 seed 组合，指黍的谷粒
黍米煮成的粥，谷物义项最常见的食品组合

senses.title: A small-seeded cereal crop
senses.definition: a fast-growing cereal grass grown for its small grain, especially in dry and hot regions
senses.definitionCN: 一种生长迅速的禾本科谷物作物，结出细小的颗粒，尤其在干热地区种植
senses.example: Farmers in the Sahel rely on millet and sorghum.
senses.exampleCN: 萨赫勒地区的农民依靠黍和高粱度日。
senses.why: The word named the plant long before it named the grain on the plate, so the crop is the primary sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指植物本身，后来才指盘中的粮食，所以「作物」是基本义项。

senses.title: The grain of the plant
senses.definition: the small edible grains of this plant, used as food for people or animals
senses.definitionCN: 这种植物结出的细小可食颗粒，用作人或动物的食物
senses.example: She cooked a bowl of millet for breakfast.
senses.exampleCN: 她早餐煮了一碗小米。
senses.why: Once harvested and husked, the same name shifts from the growing plant to the food it gives.
senses.whyCN: 收割脱壳之后，同一个词从生长的作物转为它提供的食物。

senses.title: The grass plant itself
senses.definition: any of several related tall grasses of the genus Panicum and similar genera
senses.definitionCN: 指黍属等若干相关的禾本科高秆草本植物
senses.example: Tall millet lined the edge of the sandy path.
senses.exampleCN: 高高的黍草长满了沙路两旁。
senses.why: Botanists reuse the everyday name as a general label for a group of related grasses.
senses.whyCN: 植物学家借日常叫法，把它用作一类相关禾草的统称。

senses.title: Fodder and birdseed
senses.definition: the grain used mainly as feed for poultry, cage birds, or livestock
senses.definitionCN: 主要用作家禽、笼养鸟或牲畜饲料的谷粒
senses.example: The canary pecks at its millet spray.
senses.exampleCN: 金丝雀啄着那串谷穗。
senses.why: Because the grains are tiny and cheap, they moved naturally into the feed basket.
senses.whyCN: 因为谷粒细小又便宜，很自然就被放进了饲料篮。

senses.title: An old crop unit
senses.definition: a historical unit for measuring land or seed, used in some rural regions
senses.definitionCN: 旧时某些农村地区使用的土地或种子计量单位
senses.example: The old deed records a plot of seven millet.
senses.exampleCN: 旧地契上写着一块七黍的地。
senses.why: In farming communities the crop name doubled as a measure of how much land it could fill.
senses.whyCN: 在农耕社区里，作物名兼作衡量土地用量的单位。

senses.title: Wild relatives with small seeds
senses.definition: wild grasses with very small seeds that are gathered or lightly cultivated
senses.definitionCN: 种子极小的野生禾草，被采集或粗放种植
senses.example: Villagers still gather wild millet after the rains.
senses.exampleCN: 雨后村民仍会采集野生黍。
senses.why: The plant name reached outward to any grass whose seeds are hair-fine and gathered by hand.
senses.whyCN: 植物名逐渐外延，泛指任何种子细如发丝、靠手工采收的禾草。

senses.title: A symbol of modest life
senses.definition: the grain used as a figure for plain, frugal living and hard rural work
senses.definitionCN: 用作朴素节俭生活和辛苦农活的比喻
senses.example: He was raised on millet and plain water.
senses.exampleCN: 他是靠小米和清水长大的。
senses.why: For centuries millet was the food of the poorest farms, so it became a shorthand for humble endurance.
senses.whyCN: 几个世纪里黍是最贫苦农家的口粮，因而成了朴素坚忍的代称。

senses.title: Millet as a colour
senses.definition: a pale yellow-grey colour like ripe millet, used in design and paint names
senses.definitionCN: 像成熟黍粒那样的淡黄灰色，用于设计或漆色名称
senses.example: The walls were painted a soft millet shade.
senses.exampleCN: 墙面刷成柔和的黍黄色。
senses.why: The appearance of ripened grain gives the word a second life in colour and design vocabulary.
senses.whyCN: 成熟谷粒的外观让这个词在色彩与设计用词里获得了第二次生命。

intro.en: Millet comes from French millet, from Latin milium, the name of the millet grain.
intro.cn: millet 来自法语 millet，源于拉丁语 milium，即黍这种谷物的名字。

items.en: A reconstructed root for millet grain, usually given as mel, lies behind the later words.
items.cn: 一般认为更早的形式是重构词根 mel，意为「黍粒」，是后来各形的来源。

items.en: Milium names millet and, by extension, any small-seeded grass.
items.cn: milium 指黍，并引申指任何种子细小的禾草。

items.en: Mil passes into Old French, keeping the grain sense.
items.cn: mil 进入古法语，保留谷物含义。

items.en: Middle English mil and millet appear as names of the crop and its grain.
items.cn: 中古英语里 mil 与 millet 出现，指作物及其谷粒。

items.en: Millet spreads into farming, botany, and colour terms.
items.cn: 现代英语中 millet 扩展到农学、植物学与色彩用语。

note.en: Millet is a grain name, close to its Latin relatives and to other small cereals of the same field.
note.cn: millet 是一种谷物名称，与它的拉丁同源词以及同领域的其他小粒谷物相邻。

entries.definition: the Latin name of the millet grain
resembling millet seeds, used of tiny rashes
entries.definitionCN: 像黍粒的，用于形容细小的疹子

entries.definition: a unit of distance, from Latin for a thousand paces, only spelled alike
entries.definitionCN: 距离单位，来自拉丁语「千步」，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: another drought-tolerant cereal grown in hot regions
entries.definitionCN: 另一种耐旱谷物，常与黍在干热地区同种

entries.definition: a hardy cereal grain used for food and beer
entries.definitionCN: 一种耐寒的谷物，可食用和酿酒

entries.definition: any grass grown for its edible grain
entries.definitionCN: 任何为食用谷粒而种植的禾本科作物

normalIntro.en: Millet is a tiny grain: remember the small-seeded cereal behind its Latin name milium.
normalIntro.cn: millet 是极细小的谷物：记住拉丁名 milium 所指的小粒禾本作物。

normal.en: Mil is the old short form of millet in English.
normal.cn: 古英语里 mil 是 millet 的短形。

normal.en: Latin milium gives both millet and the medical word miliary.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 milium 既给了 millet，也给了医学术语 miliary。

normal.en: Pearl millet and finger millet are the two commonest species names.
normal.cn: 珍珠粟和䅟子是两种最常见的种类名。

normal.en: A millet spray is the seed head sold as bird food.
normal.cn: a millet spray 就是当作鸟食出售的谷穗。

normal.en: Compare maize and rice: millet is the small grain of dry land.
normal.cn: 对比玉米与稻米：millet 是旱地上的小粒谷物。

abstract.en: Imagine a fistful of grains so small they run between the fingers.
abstract.cn: 想象一把谷粒小到能从指缝里漏下去。

abstract.en: Think of a golden field on cracked dry soil after weeks of sun.
abstract.cn: 想象晒了几周的干裂土地上金黄的黍田。

abstract.en: Picture a bowl of pale porridge steaming on a poor farm table.
abstract.cn: 想象贫苦农家的桌上放着一碗冒热气的淡色粥。

examples.en: A bowl of hot millet is a cheap breakfast.
examples.cn: 一碗热小米粥是廉价的早餐。

examples.en: Farmers planted millet because it survives long dry spells.
examples.cn: 农民种黍，因为它能熬过漫长的旱季。

examples.en: Different millets suit different soils and rainfalls.
examples.cn: 不同的黍类适应不同的土壤和降雨。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「咪了它」——猫把一小粒谷子「咪」地一下吃了，小米就这么小；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 milium（黍粒）→ 古法语 mil → 英语 mil / millet，核心义「小粒黍谷」。

sensesIntro.en: Millet names the plant first, then its grain, then the feed, measure, colour, and figure that grew from it.
sensesIntro.cn: millet 先指黍这种作物，再指它的谷粒，随后扩展出饲料、度量、颜色与比喻等义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dense head of tiny grains in a dry field.
core.cn: 核心意象：旱地里一穗密密麻麻的小谷粒。

branches.en: The cereal crop is the original and central sense.
branches.cn: 黍类作物是最初也是中心的义项。

branches.en: The harvested grain is the sense most people meet on a plate.
branches.cn: 收获的谷粒是大多数人盘中见到的义项。

branches.en: Botany splits the name into cultivated grasses and wild small-seeded relatives.
branches.cn: 植物学把这个名字分成栽培禾草与野生小粒近缘种两类。

branches.en: Cheap tiny grain becomes bird feed and even a measure of land.
branches.cn: 便宜细小的谷粒被当作鸟食，甚至用作土地的计量单位。

branches.en: The poorest food turns into a figure for hard living and a colour shade.
branches.cn: 最贫苦的口粮转化为艰苦生活的比喻与一种色调。

intro.en: Millet is a simple borrowed noun with almost no affixes, so its word family grows by compounding.
intro.cn: millet 是几乎没有词缀的借用名词，它的词族主要靠合成法扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin milium is the direct source and the base of the rare English adjective miliary.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 milium 是直接来源，也是罕见英语形容词 miliary 的基础。

items.example: Milium is the Latin name of millet.
items.exampleCN: milium 是黍的拉丁名。

items.example: The ending -et makes millet a small mil.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -et 使 millet 成为小号的 mil。

items.example: Mil is the older English spelling.
items.exampleCN: mil 是较早的英语拼写。

items.example: Millet is the standard modern form.
items.exampleCN: millet 是现代标准形式。

items.example: Miliary describes tiny seed-like spots.
items.exampleCN: miliary 描述细小如籽的斑点。

items.example: Millet-based diets are common in dry areas.
items.exampleCN: 以黍米为主的饮食在干旱地区很常见。

items.meaning: built on a given main material
items.meaningCN: 表示以某物为主要成分的词尾
items.example: The suffix -based forms millet-based.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -based 构成 millet-based。

items.example: Millet seed is scattered by hand.
items.exampleCN: 黍种靠手撒播。

items.example: Millet porridge is a warm winter meal.
items.exampleCN: 小米粥是暖冬的一餐。

items.meaning: used in the species name finger millet
items.meaningCN: 用于品种名中，指穗形似手指
items.example: Finger millet stands on dry slopes.
items.exampleCN: 䅟子长在干燥的坡地上。

definition_zh: 哑剧；默剧表演；哑剧演员；用动作示意；模仿
definition_en: the art of acting without words, or to act out or imitate something using only movements
core_image: 演员蒙着白脸、戴着手套，只用双手在空中「说」一句话
scene: 街头围起一圈人，白脸演员不开口，只用双手摸到一扇看不见的门。A white-faced performer stands in the street and mimes opening an invisible door.
sceneCN: 这里 mime 是「用动作表现」（第 2 个义项：不发声，仅靠身体动作表演）；句意：一位白脸演员站在街上，用动作表演打开一扇看不见的门。

pos.zh: 哑剧；默剧表演；哑剧演员
用动作示意；做哑剧表演；模仿

derivatives.zh: 模仿；模仿者，与 mime 同出希腊语 mimos
模仿；拟态，由 mimic 加名词后缀 -ry 构成
模仿的；模拟的，由希腊语词根加 -etic 构成
哑剧演员；模仿者，由 mime 加表人后缀 -er 构成

senses.title: The silent art of acting
senses.definition: a form of theatre in which stories are told through gesture and movement rather than speech
senses.definitionCN: 一种不靠台词、而用动作和表情讲述故事的戏剧形式
senses.example: She has studied mime in Paris for three years.
senses.exampleCN: 她在巴黎学了三年哑剧。
senses.why: The Greek word mimos named an imitation of life on stage, and silent acting is that imitation at its purest.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 mimos 指舞台上的生活模仿，而无声表演正是这种模仿最纯粹的形式。

senses.title: To act something out silently
senses.definition: to show an action, feeling, or meaning with gestures instead of words
senses.definitionCN: 不用语言，而用手势、动作表达某个行为、情绪或含义
senses.example: He mimed unlocking a door and stepping inside.
senses.exampleCN: 他用动作比划着开锁进屋。
senses.why: When the stage verb left the theatre, it kept its core move: representing an action without speech.
senses.whyCN: 当动词离开舞台进入日常，它保留了核心动作：不用言语来表现一个行为。

senses.title: A performer without words
senses.definition: a person who performs silent theatre, often with a painted white face
senses.definitionCN: 从事无声戏剧表演的人，常涂着白色脸谱
senses.example: A mime stopped in front of the fountain and bowed.
senses.exampleCN: 一名哑剧演员停在喷泉前鞠了一躬。
senses.why: By metonymy the art name became the name of the person who practises it.
senses.whyCN: 由借代关系，艺术名称变成了从事这门艺术的人的称谓。

senses.title: An imitation or farce
senses.definition: an old, usually comic, imitation of a person or situation
senses.definitionCN: 旧时对人物或情境的模仿，多为喜剧性的
senses.example: The court mime mocked the bishop without a single word.
senses.exampleCN: 宫廷里的模仿表演一言不发地嘲弄了主教。
senses.why: The earliest mimes were improvised sketches that copied and mocked real people.
senses.whyCN: 最早的哑剧就是即兴短剧，模仿并嘲弄现实中的人。

senses.title: To mouth words silently
senses.definition: to move the lips as if speaking words that are not actually voiced
senses.definitionCN: 只动嘴唇做出说话的形状而不发出声音
senses.example: Across the classroom she mimed the answer to her friend.
senses.exampleCN: 她隔着教室用手势口型把答案告诉朋友。
senses.why: Silence is the shared thread, so the sense stretches from whole-body acting to lips alone.
senses.whyCN: 「无声」是共同的线索，所以含义从全身表演延伸到只动嘴唇。

senses.title: In biology: mimic
senses.definition: to copy the appearance or behaviour of another species for protection or advantage
senses.definitionCN: 为了自保或获益而模仿另一物种的外形或行为
senses.example: Some harmless insects mime the markings of wasps.
senses.exampleCN: 一些无害昆虫模仿黄蜂的花纹。
senses.why: Science adopted the old imitation sense to describe animals that copy a dangerous model.
senses.whyCN: 科学借用了古老的「模仿」义，用来描述动物复制危险模式的现象。

intro.en: Mime comes from Greek mimos, an imitator or mimic, which passed through Latin and French into English.
intro.cn: mime 源自希腊语 mimos（模仿者），经拉丁语和法语进入英语。

items.en: Mimos names an actor who imitates people and scenes without masks.
items.cn: mimos 指不戴面具模仿人物与场景的演员。

items.en: Mimus keeps the stage sense of an imitative actor or play.
items.cn: mimus 保留模仿型演员或戏剧的舞台义。

items.en: Mime arrives as the name of a short comic imitation.
items.cn: mime 以「滑稽短剧」之名进入古法语。

items.en: Mime enters English as a term of the classical theatre.
items.cn: 十七世纪 mime 作为古典戏剧术语进入英语。

items.en: Modern English turns mime into silent acting and the verb to act it out.
items.cn: 现代英语使 mime 指无声表演，并派生出让动词「比划表演」。

note.en: Mime belongs to a Greek family of imitation words and is close to silent-stage and copying verbs.
note.cn: mime 属于希腊语「模仿」词族，并与「无声表演」「复制」类动词相邻。

entries.definition: to copy the way someone speaks or moves
entries.definitionCN: 模仿某人说话或动作的方式

entries.definition: the act of copying, or a species copying another
entries.definitionCN: 模仿行为，或物种间的拟态

entries.definition: relating to imitation
acting entirely by gesture, or a comic Christmas play
entries.definitionCN: 全靠动作的表演，或英国圣诞滑稽剧

entries.definition: a movement of the body that carries meaning
to copy someone or something

normalIntro.en: Mime means imitation with no voice: remember the Greek mimos, an imitator on stage.
normalIntro.cn: mime 指不带声音的模仿：记住希腊语 mimos 就是舞台上的模仿者。

normal.en: Mimic and mimicry share the same Greek root.
normal.cn: mimic 与 mimicry 同出希腊语词根。

normal.en: To mime the action is to show it with your body.
normal.cn: mime the action 就是用身体把那动作示意出来。

normal.en: A mime artist traditionally paints the face white.
normal.cn: 哑剧演员传统上把脸涂成白色。

normal.en: Mime someone is to copy their movements.
normal.cn: mime someone 就是照抄对方的动作。

normal.en: Compare pantomime: it is longer and often a Christmas show.
normal.cn: 对比 pantomime：词更长，常指圣诞滑稽剧。

abstract.en: Picture two hands pulling an invisible rope.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手在拉一根看不见的绳子。

abstract.en: Think of a face that smiles but makes no sound.
abstract.cn: 想象一张笑着却不出声的脸。

abstract.en: See a person mouthing a word through a closed window.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人隔着关上的窗用口型说话。

examples.en: The workshop teaches children to mime simple stories.
examples.cn: 这个工作坊教孩子们用动作表演简单故事。

examples.en: From the far side of the pool he mimed waving.
examples.cn: 他从泳池另一边比划着挥手。

examples.en: Mime needs a sharp eye for how bodies move.
examples.cn: 哑剧需要对身体动作有敏锐的观察。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「麦姆」——白脸演员演到精彩处，观众心里只冒出「麦姆」两个字，却听不见任何台词；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 mimos（模仿者）→ 拉丁语 mimus → 古法语 mime → 英语 mime，核心义「无声的模仿演绎」。

sensesIntro.en: Mime starts as the silent stage art, spreads to the verb for acting out anything, then to the performer and to biological mimicry.
sensesIntro.cn: mime 先指无声的舞台艺术，再扩展为「用动作表现任何事物」的动词，随后指表演者，又延伸到生物拟态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hands shaping an invisible object in mid-air.
core.cn: 核心意象：双手在半空中捏出一件看不见的东西。

branches.en: The silent stage art is the named form of performance.
branches.cn: 无声的舞台艺术是这门表演样式的名称。

branches.en: The verb shows anything without voice, from the whole body to the lips.
branches.cn: 动词表示无声音地表现任何东西，从全身动作到只动嘴唇。

branches.en: The art name passes by metonymy to the person who performs it.
branches.cn: 艺术名称经借代转为从事表演的人。

branches.en: Both the classical farce and the modern silent art rest on imitation.
branches.cn: 古典滑稽短剧与现代无声艺术都建立在模仿之上。

branches.en: Biology borrows the same copying move for animals that imitate a model.
branches.cn: 生物学借用同样的「复制动作」来描述模仿模式物的动物。

intro.en: Mime is a root formed as-is, with mimic, mimicry, mimetic, and mimer built around the Greek base.
intro.cn: mime 本身就是词根形式，mimic、mimicry、mimetic 与 mimer 都围绕希腊语词基构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin mimus carries the Greek word for an imitating actor into later European forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mimus 把希腊语「模仿型演员」一词带入后来欧洲各语言的形式。

items.example: Greek mimos names the actor who copies life.
items.exampleCN: 希腊语 mimos 指模仿生活的演员。

items.example: Latin mimus keeps the stage sense.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 mimus 保留舞台含义。

items.example: Mime is both the art and the act.
items.exampleCN: mime 既是艺术形式也是动作。

items.example: Mimic is the plain copying verb.
items.exampleCN: mimic 是直白的「模仿」动词。

items.example: The suffix -ic forms mimic.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ic 构成 mimic 的形容词形。

items.example: Mimicry is common in butterflies.
items.exampleCN: 蝴蝶中的拟态很常见。

items.meaningCN: 表示行为或活动的名词词尾
